sloka: कच्चिद्धृष्टश्च शूरश्च मतिमान् धृतिमाञ्छुचि: ।कुलीनश्चानुरक्तश्च दक्ष: सेनापति: कृत: ॥ २.१००.३१॥
transliteration: kacciddhṛṣṭaśca śūraśca matimān dhṛtimāñchuci: ।kulīnaścānuraktaśca dakṣa: senāpati: kṛta: ॥ 2.100.31॥

translations.english: I trust you honour and respect those prominent soldiers who are courageous, powerful, skilled in war and who have proven heroic exploits.
